post.title: Good debt vs bad debt: the rate test, explained with acorns
post.ig:
Cards charge about 22%. Can borrowed money be smart?
The Fed's average card APR on accounts paying interest was 22.36% in Q3 2026, up from a 16.45% average in 2021.
The federal undergrad student loan rate for 2026-27 is 6.52%. Our math: $1,000 for one year costs $223.60 at 22.36% vs $65.20 at 6.52% (simple interest).
The 30-year mortgage averaged 7.11% for the week of Nov 12, 2026 (Freddie Mac). The test: what the debt costs vs what it earns or saves.
Sources: Federal Reserve G.19 / FRED TERMCBCCINTNS (Q3 2026 data); Federal Student Aid and Federal Register (2026-27 rates); Freddie Mac PMMS (Nov 12, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
